rules: Every ci_stage_order stage (kind stage) and every other ci-local.sh run label (kind trailing) is listed once. cost: light (no cargo build), build (compiles a cargo target), heavy (full suite or release build). Each entry carries exactly one of: ledger (ids of real failures it caught), provisionalUntil (date by which a real failure or a deterrent reason is due), deterrent (why the gate stays without a recorded failure). Record failures with ci-failure.sh --record.

gates.prevents: a candidate whose public history leaks private or rewritten commits
gates.deterrent: public-history boundary: a leak cannot be recalled after push

gates.prevents: a GitHub workflow that is invalid or unpinned reaching the default branch
gates.deterrent: workflow mistakes run with repository credentials before anyone reads them

gates.prevents: the workflow validator silently accepting a bad workflow
stage membership drifting between full and pre-return modes
the quiet-command log wrapper losing exit codes or output
unformatted Rust reaching review
gates.deterrent: formatting drift makes every later diff noisy; costs seconds

gates.prevents: a path converted to text outside the allowlisted renderers
experimental code, unlisted dependencies, stale test-target, package, skill, legacy-reader or gate inventories
Rust lint findings reaching review
gates.deterrent: lint debt compounds across a 1.75-pinned toolchain

gates.prevents: a behaviour regression anywhere in the full test suite
gates.deterrent: the only stage that runs every test target

gates.prevents: a source file or module growing past its size or ownership budget
operator-private names or terms in tracked content
gates.deterrent: a public push cannot be recalled

gates.prevents: version, changelog and release metadata disagreeing
gates.deterrent: a wrong release reference ships to every installer

gates.prevents: broken documentation links and stale documented claims
the first-run path for a new user regressing
the value report contract changing shape
plugin manifests and packaged plugin files disagreeing
a pre-return candidate breaking test targets its diff touches
the false-completion value proof no longer holding
gates.deterrent: the product's central claim; full mode only

gates.prevents: the drift-warning demo no longer warning
the real tmux child handoff losing bound evidence
current guides and manifests naming a stale release
gates.deterrent: stale install references reach users at release

gates.prevents: the release binary failing to build
the release binary failing the onboarding smoke
a release archive with missing or extra files
gates.deterrent: the archive is what users install

gates.prevents: the installer failing to install the packaged archive
gates.deterrent: the installer is the documented install path
